invariant_argument: Factorial maintains product=i! after processing i. Binomial maintains result=choose(n-m+i,i); multiplying by n-m+i then dividing by i is integral by the standard subset-counting identity. BigUint multiplication cannot wrap; n-m+i<=n and i>=1 prevent machine overflow and zero division. Choice m is bounded before the loop. No factorial or binomial value is converted approximately.

Permutation suffix search first proves n>=2, then maintains 0<=i<n while decreasing it. If i=0, no successor exists and the word has not been touched. Otherwise a greater suffix element exists because items[i]>items[i-1]; the decreasing j search must stop at or above i. The swap and reversal are in range and construct the least lexicographic greater multiset permutation. Iteration therefore terminates on the finite family without repeats.

Combination validation precedes n-k subtraction. For a valid increasing subset, coordinate i is at most n-k+i<=n-1. A strict smaller-than guard makes increment safe and leaves room for every reconstructed suffix coordinate. Lexicographic successor is therefore total on admitted slices, strictly increasing until the final subset, and preserves cardinality and bounds. Invalid input returns false without writes.

Weak-composition zero-part cases are explicit. Positive parts satisfy the stars-and-bars bijection between nonnegative rows summing to total and subsets of total+parts-1 positions; upper-index addition is checked before binomial. Width is bounded before counting, row count before cells, and exact BigUint cell count before scratch/output allocation. Count zero implies no emitted rows; parts zero with total zero emits precisely one empty row.

In an admitted nonempty composition row, every entry is at most total and the sum is total. The chosen rightmost positive coordinate after index zero has only zeros to its right. Removing that coordinate, transferring one unit left and moving its remainder to the last coordinate preserves total. The predecessor is strictly below total before increment, so even total=usize::MAX cannot overflow. This is exactly the next lexicographic row: keep the longest possible prefix, increase its last mutable coordinate minimally, and minimize the suffix by concentrating its sum at the final coordinate. The terminal row has all mass in coordinate zero. Every row occurs once, and the finite admitted count bounds traversal.

Private iterator fields cannot be replaced by callers. Constructors check domain, row budget and owned-width bounds before vector construction. Clone preserves these invariants. Iterator failure/exhaustion clears state; raw error records and diagnostic strings do not certify mathematical models. No deserialization, unsafe block, arbitrary callback or unchecked public model constructor appears.

Weak compositions retain at most 1048576 scalar cells and a width<=4096 scratch row, with constant call-stack depth instead of recursive depth=parts. On the tested 64-bit target a conservative row-header overhead is at most 24 times the cell bound, plus scalar cells and scratch. This is a logical storage bound, not an allocator or process-memory guarantee. Eager permutations/combinations honor caller row limits; their aggregate memory budget is not promised independently of caller limits. Lazy iterators keep only one bounded row; each emitted row is necessarily owned.

factorial_exact: Loop product after iteration i is i!; empty product is 1.
binomial_step: Each source loop multiplies the previous choose value before exact division by positive i.
binomial_step_integral: The numerator has no discarded remainder.
binomial_final: At m iterations the offset n-m yields choose(n,m).
symmetric_choice: m=min(k,n-k) does not change the mathematical value when k<=n.
choose_outside: The explicit k>n return is the standard zero convention.
numerator_fits: m<=n and i<=m imply n-m+i<=n<=u64::MAX before BigUint conversion.
composition_count: For positive parts the stars-and-bars number is multichoose(parts,total). The row/multiset bijection and lexicographic storage correspondence are separately reviewed.
no_parts_nonzero: Positive total with no parts has zero rows.
empty_composition: Zero total and no parts has one empty row.
admission_exact: After successful exact count construction the width, row and cell bounds characterize resource acceptance. Checked count-overflow/choice errors remain an earlier separate typed path.
rows_before_cells: A failing row budget precedes a failing cell budget, once count exists.
cells_refused: An exact count*parts above the cap refuses before scratch/output construction.
pivot_sum: All coordinates after the selected positive pivot are zero. Removing the pivot, transferring one unit left and placing the remainder at the end preserves the total.
pivot_increment_fits: The positive pivot and sum bound protect the predecessor increment even at usize::MAX.
pivot_remainder_lt: rposition selects a nonzero coordinate, hence subtraction cannot underflow.
subset_increment_fits: Only validated increasing subsets enter this branch; increment stays below n.
